purpose: Declare captured-world dependency edges for exact or conservative incremental repair experiments.

edgeFields.exact: true if dependency is proven exact, false if conservative

changeFields.changedSources: source node ids directly invalidated by a new capture/edit
changeFields.expectedAffected: optional exhaustive-oracle affected node ids on tiny scenes

outputMetrics: false-negative invalidations (must be zero for correctness)
rule: No global artifact may be silently omitted from the graph because it is inconvenient to instrument.
